Shavit reels · The Website + Kendall Street

Spec v1.3 (v1.2 + sign-off amendments: fast swipes, hero beat on the live case-study page) · 2026-08-16 · owner: Jake · Horvitz run shavit-product-edit stage 3 · status: signed v1.3 · references + previs: Shavit Edit Dossier

1. Problem & goal

Showcase the features of shavitrootman.com in a really cool fashion on Instagram, in the visual language of award-tier "product edit" websites (pinned chapters with copy swaps, scroll-scrubbed reveals, before→after hairline wipes, counting numbers, big uppercase type, premium device frames), inside Shavit's register. Two reels, two posts. Reel 1 doubles as the marketing-revamp announcement Shavit asked for on 7/5.

Success looks like: both reels approved by Shavit for posting; Reel 1 posted as the announcement; the register gate green; day-7 impressions + saves read against the slate's median. Jake's bar: "think luxury, think Porsche, think AirPods. I don't want it to look shitty."

2. Users

Shavit's Instagram audience (5,060 followers, reactivating): prospective and current tenants first, then lenders, partners, sellers. Register goal is reputation, not virality.

3. Mockups visual contract

Reel 2 previs (built, captured): Palmier project Shavit Website Edit - The Turn (previs) → timelines SPEC 1 (21s desktop animatic + chapter notes), SPEC 2 (key-frame storyboard), SPEC 3 (phone fallback). Source mockup docs/product-edit/mockup/the-turn.html; master mockup/the-turn-previs-desktop.mp4. It will be re-shot 9:16 for the reel (same code, portrait viewport).

Reel 1 storyboard (rendered from live-site captures in device frames):

0–3s · Hook

Black. Gold hairline draws. Phone rises into frame with the live hero, tilted. Type: "A new home for the homes we manage." Music bed in.

Phone scrolls the Michigan row (real capture); call-out "Every home, every rent, no forms." Swipe gesture implied by the carousel moving.

9–14s · Deal Case Studies

Wide (desktop) frame of the case-studies band; type "Learn more about our numbers." Cursor lands on Read the case study.

Full-bleed. Kendall exterior before→after wipe on a gold hairline (previs footage re-cut 9:16), "Rebuilt." Numbers stay in caption copy unless Shavit rules yes.

24–30s · Text us

Phone on the Tenants Q&A / Text Us; type "Questions? Text us." 805-364-4415 (site CTA).

30–35s · End card

Static mark + SHAVIT ROOTMAN + shavitrootman.com + "Managed by Charger Property Management". Logo draws once, holds. Music resolves.

Device test

The 3D question: free path is CSS perspective + gloss + shadow captured as video (this frame); upgrade path is Rotato renders or Palmier 3D layouts. Jake judges the bar.

Reel 2 storyboard (previs stills, to be re-framed 9:16):

Pipeline

  • Footage: headless-Chromium captures of the LIVE site (intro/boot-cover removed via ?kill=intro + DOM removal): phone 390×844 @3x and desktop 1600×1000, both as 30fps scroll videos and stills; the previs mockup re-shot at 1080×1920. Device frames: CSS phone/laptop frames with perspective, gloss and shadow (free path), captured as video; Rotato/Palmier 3D as the upgrade if Jake judges the CSS frames not premium enough.
  • Edit: Palmier project (renamed to Shavit Reels - Website + Kendall) with timelines REEL 1, REEL 2, plus the storyboards; text layers in the register style; music bed from the slate's beds; shared end card duplicated from the master project.
  • Export: export_project → mp4 h264/aac 1080×1920 30fps; caption drafts per templates/reel-caption.md written with jakevoice; nothing posted by me.

5. Non-goals / anti-requirements hard don'ts

  • No voice-over. Nothing generated (no AI property imagery, no outpaint, no generated people). No new photography. No site changes. (Jake, 8/15)
  • Register (video-brain, Shavit): black canvas, white uppercase type, gold rules only; real photos only; no digit-leading street address on screen ("Kendall Street", never "1919 …"); Michigan / Ohio / Indiana spelled out; no pulsing or looping logo — draws once, holds; Ken-Burns ≤20% of still-derived runtime, never on the hook; disparage the house never the street; de-identify any person; calm not viral.
  • Dollar figures burned into picture are UNRULED (caption-copy figures approved 8/7). Default = none on picture; Shavit's yes flips it. Same ruling covers the case-study card copy visible in captures.
  • Captures must avoid or crop the site's own "Hillsdale, MI" hero chip and any digit-leading address in card copy, or Shavit rules them acceptable as site UI. The OCR gate reports every hit; Jake decides.
  • Drafts, not posts. Jake/Shavit post. No IG API. No Higgsfield credits (nothing to generate).
  • Do not re-cut the existing slate reels; do not reuse the "written off" framing (keep "REBUILT").

9. Acceptance — executable accept-edit.sh

The build is accepted when ./accept-edit.sh exits 0 against the two exported mp4s (paths pinned in the script) — the Horvitz stage-5 gate re-runs it independently. Then the 5.5 conformance check re-reads this spec against the Palmier timelines. Checks:

  1. Both exports exist; ffprobe: 1080×1920, 30/1 fps, h264 video + aac audio, duration 30–45s each.
  2. OCR sweep (tesseract on 2 frames/sec, money regex = real amounts, addresses case-insensitive): overlay hits (our type, Reel 2, The Turn beat) FAIL; hits inside Reel 1's device-frame beats (2–15s, 24–29s) are site UI verbatim and WARN with timestamp + context for Shavit's ruling (Jake 8/16: "everything's good on the site to publish"). Zero overlay hits for $ (unless the ruling flag is set), for \b\d{2,5}\s+[A-Z][a-z]+ (Street|St|Ave|Rd) (digit-leading addresses), for standalone MI/OH/IN as state abbreviations, and for the holding-company names. Every hit is printed with its timestamp so Jake can rule.
  3. Static signature: pixel diff of the mark region across the last 2.2s < threshold (logo does not pulse); no black-frame ending.
  4. Audio: a non-silent audio stream present in both.
  5. Palmier conformance (v1.2): the composition is rendered deterministically by reel1/reel1.html and mockup/the-turn.html (frame-by-frame, no dropped frames) into a base mp4; Palmier timelines REEL 1 / REEL 2 hold base + music bed spanning 1050 frames, with SPEC 1–3 storyboards alongside. get_timeline must show both timelines at 1050 frames with a video and an audio track.
  6. Register: frame.html/mockup CSS contains no generated-image references; no Higgsfield calls in the journal.
  7. Files ≤ 200 MB; caption drafts exist and contain no em dashes/contractions (jakevoice rule).

11. Council verdict

Second-pass critique (stage 4, low stakes → one outside voice, gemini CLI, 2026-08-16; full text docs/product-edit/COUNCIL-gemini-critique.md).

Verdict: APPROVE WITH CHANGES — all four adopted:

  • Address on screen is exactly "Kendall Street · South Bend, Indiana" (never a digit); Reel 2's "address small" means that string.
  • Case-study card figures in the desktop capture: the Mac beat lands on the section heading and cuts before card body copy is legible; the OCR gate reports any hit with a timestamp and Jake rules (site-UI-verbatim question for Shavit stands).
  • Hook is sequential, not stacked: Mac beat (0–2s) → hard cut to phone rise (2–4s); the shot list's hook window widens to 0–4s and "Available now" starts at 4s. Never two devices in one 9:16 frame.
  • Capture fidelity: footage is rendered frame by frame at rest (deterministic, no dropped frames by construction, 3× DPR phone captures); if any beat looks soft or jittery, a manual high-DPI macOS screen recording is the sanctioned fallback input.

Dissent / risks: device frames + 3D perspective in headless CSS is called an overbuild risk for one day; mitigation = the free CSS frames already render (see storyboard) and Rotato is the upgrade, not the default.
